scope: One immutable shared control. Aliases do not add bindings. Complete backing observations can overlap those of other allocations on a page; budget statistics alone give the domain total.
consistency: All fields are captured under the same control lock. Payload-return completion updates payload gauges under that lock; this is not an atomic transaction with a budget, provider or process snapshot.
resetPolicy: No capture or lifecycle transition resets histories or recorded peaks. Expiration permanently closes strong publication and drops the strong bank; the weak bank drops when its last observer ends. Prepared bounds and identities survive terminal cleanup.
availability: All 26 fields are implemented independently of optional tracing. Payload-return success is not physical backend-free success; expired readers or failed cleanup may still retain backing.
oracleScope: Every property is compared at each independently modeled public stage: acquisition, strong/weak exhaustion, share/slice, upgrade, detach admission and copy, payload return with surviving observation, expired upgrade and bank release. Only stable identities are observed to seed expected state. Unsuppressed package callbacks are static and do not capture owners; their snapshots occur outside entered reads. Independent local cases compare all properties inside nested entered reads and drain, after failed cleanup and retry, and with real provider-owned backing. This scope distinction is deliberate, not a claim that the packaged callback exercises every nonzero state.
unreviewedScope: Remaining owner/prepared/admission/retention/layout/unique schemas, full trace and API/lifecycle inventory, diagnostic costs and benefit matrix, native platform gates and final release remain open.

fields.name: Id
fields.definition: Positive process-local non-reusing sharing-control identity, distinct from original backing lineage; not an address or a payload pin.
fields.overflow: Checked identity allocation fails before publication and never wraps.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.definition: Original unique backing-owner lineage retained through sharing, expiration and cleanup; not a new native allocation.
fields.overflow: Already validated stable source identity; snapshot creates no identity.

fields.name: Preparation
fields.definition: Immutable declared independent binding capacities; initial publication consumes one strong slot. Capacity remains declared after arrays are dropped.
fields.overflow: Invalid/negative bounds reject before unique consumption; capacity is bounded by successfully allocated metadata.

fields.name: StrongBindingCount
fields.definition: Currently independently acquired strong slot occupancy, not ordinary copies. Zero after permanent expiration, even with an entered reader or pending cleanup.
fields.overflow: Exact within prepared bounds; slot-version exhaustion rejects before changing occupancy.

fields.name: WeakBindingCount
fields.definition: Independently acquired weak slot occupancy. Expiration does not release surviving observers; aliases cannot release reused slots.
fields.overflow: Exact prepared-capacity gauge, independent of saturating histories.

fields.name: ActiveReadCount
fields.definition: Reads actually admitted and not yet exited, including nested reads and reads finishing after last strong release. A payload return waits for this count to reach zero.
fields.overflow: Checked admission rejects before increment; exit rejects count underflow.

fields.name: PeakStrongBindingCount
fields.definition: Maximum successfully published simultaneous strong occupancy, including initial, share, slice and upgrade; not reset by release or expiration.
fields.overflow: Exact maximum bounded by prepared strong capacity.

fields.name: PeakWeakBindingCount
fields.definition: Maximum successfully published simultaneous observer occupancy, not count of aliases or total observer acquisitions.
fields.overflow: Exact maximum bounded by prepared weak capacity.

fields.name: Expired
fields.definition: Strong publication permanently closed by last strong release or observed payload abandonment. May precede payload return while an entered read or cleanup retry remains.
fields.overflow: Monotonic boolean; no resurrection or reset.

fields.name: PayloadReleased
fields.definition: True only after successful payload-authority return, not after its attempt or expiration. Pooled backing can remain physically acquired and charged after true.
fields.overflow: Monotonic successful completion, independent of saturating history.

fields.name: OwnedBackingBytes
fields.definition: Complete known NAM-owned extent pinned through this payload, including pooled page slack. Counted once within this control, not additive across page occupants. Zero after return; failed cleanup and entered readers retain it.
fields.overflow: Checked actual extent; never derived from saturated histories.

fields.name: BorrowedBackingBytes
fields.definition: Complete associated provider-owned extent, separate from NAM-owned storage and its budget. Current public unique creators acquire owned backing; the internal external-region conversion mechanism is independently tested with a real SafeBuffer.
fields.overflow: Checked real provider extent; no fabricated native allocation/free credit.

fields.name: InitializedPayloadBytes
fields.definition: Original initialized logical range counted once, not once per overlapping strong binding or slice. Remains visible during entered-read drain and failed cleanup, zero only after successful return.
fields.overflow: Exact Int32 length times supported element size represented as Int64; no additive alias demand.

fields.name: PeakInitializedPayloadBytes
fields.definition: Original immutable initialized extent retained after payload return. Sharing and slices never increase it.
fields.overflow: Exact immutable logical extent, not an event history.

fields.name: ManagedBankBytes
fields.definition: Actual current strong/weak slot-array element storage. Drops the whole strong bank at expiration and the whole weak bank after its last expired observer. Excludes CLR object/array headers, control objects, and unreachable arrays awaiting GC.
fields.overflow: Checked sum of actual retained array extents; no count-history derivation.

fields.name: ShareCount
fields.definition: Successful explicit share and slice publications, excluding the initial owner, ordinary aliases and weak upgrades.
fields.overflow: Saturates at Int64.MaxValue and marks HistoryOverflowed on a further completed acquisition, without failing ownership work.

fields.name: WeakCreationCount
fields.definition: Successful independent weak publications, excluding aliases and rejected acquisitions.
fields.overflow: Saturating lifetime history; further events mark HistoryOverflowed while exact occupancy stays valid.

fields.name: SuccessfulUpgradeCount
fields.definition: Successful weak-to-strong publications; expiration and capacity refusals do not receive success credit.
fields.overflow: Saturating lifetime history independent of non-wrapping binding versions.

fields.name: RejectedStrongCount
fields.definition: Valid share/slice/upgrade attempts refused for exhausted strong slots. Invalid/stale ownership throws without pretending to be capacity exhaustion.
fields.overflow: Saturates with HistoryOverflowed; refusal still defaults outputs and preserves earlier owners.

fields.name: RejectedWeakCount
fields.definition: Valid downgrade requests refused for exhausted weak slots, not invalid ownership or payload expiration.
fields.overflow: Saturates with HistoryOverflowed without allocating a refused observer.

fields.name: ExpiredUpgradeCount
fields.definition: Valid observer upgrades refused after permanent payload expiration; stale released observers are errors, not counted expiration attempts.
fields.overflow: Saturates with HistoryOverflowed while preserving no-resurrection semantics.

fields.name: PayloadReturnCount
fields.definition: Successfully completed return of this payload authority, including empty or reusable pooled payloads; one per control, not a physical free, alias disposal or retry count.
fields.overflow: Production successful return occurs once; uses non-throwing saturating history machinery and does not disturb cleanup.

fields.name: DetachCount
fields.definition: Successful fully published explicit unique detach copies, including zero-length owners; not backend reallocations or automatic slice shrinking.
fields.overflow: Saturates with HistoryOverflowed after completed destination publication, without failing it.

fields.name: RejectedDetachCount
fields.definition: Explicit destination-budget rejection before backing acquisition/copy; source authority survives. Backend or publication failures remain exceptions and do not invent capacity refusal.
fields.overflow: Saturating history without mutating source or allocating a refusal wrapper.

fields.name: PayloadReturnFailureCount
fields.definition: Actual failed payload-return attempts; pending readers that prevent an attempt are not failures, and failed attempts do not clear extents or credit success. Explicit or emergency retries preserve obligations.
fields.overflow: Saturates with HistoryOverflowed while retaining cleanup authority.

fields.name: HistoryOverflowed
fields.definition: At least one completed lifetime history exceeded exact Int64 capacity. Reaching the maximum exactly is not alone overflow. Gauges, peaks and binding authority remain exact.
fields.overflow: Sticky for this control's lifetime; no capture/reset or counter-disable mode.
